title: was this fixed?

items.content: Find out why cancel + close lost agent data (code path + on-disk evidence in aura_data)

Make quitting graceful: SessionTask::finish signals the event loop to shut down and waits (bounded) so cancelled turns save checkpoints, instead of aborting it; TUI runner drops the UI before waiting; regression tests
Independent review of the graceful-quit change (cancellation safety, bounded wait, tests)
Report root cause, fix, what was lost and follow-ups (mid-turn checkpoints, spawn sessions, turn-timeout loss)

summary: No, not confirmed yet. The fix agent hit its 10-minute limit before it reported back. I'll look at what it actually changed on disk.
